title: Harm Budget for Agents
description: Policy for bounding the worst-case harm an owner's agents can do in a period. See README.en.md.

budget.description: Harm budget per period, in `currency`. Shared by all of the owner's agents and gates.

period_seconds.description: Length of a budget period in seconds.

currency.description: Unit of harm, usually a currency code such as RUB or USD.

pool_file.description: Path to the owner's shared pool state file. Every gate of one owner opens the same file. When absent, only the per-call exposure caps apply and there is no shared pool.

reserve_ttl_seconds.description: A reservation not settled within this time is booked as spent, for crash safety. Clamped to period_seconds.

unknown_action_exposure.description: Exposure assumed for action tools not listed in `tools`. null means such tools are not limited.

tools.description: Per-tool exposure rules, keyed by tool name.

tool.description: How to read the worst-case cost of one call of this tool, and the most it may cost without a human.

exposure.description: Fixed worst-case cost of one call, for tools whose cost does not vary.

amount_arg.description: Dotted path to the argument whose numeric value is the worst case, for a payment or refund.

count_arg.description: Dotted path to the argument whose count drives the worst case, for a bulk read or export.

per_item.description: Cost per item, multiplied by count_arg.

default_count.description: Count used when count_arg is absent from the call.

ceiling.description: Exposure used when the amount or count cannot be read. Default is unbounded, so an unreadable call fails closed.

max_per_action.description: The most one call of this tool may cost without a human. A call above it is held. 0 means the tool always needs a human.

rules.description: Ordered rules for cost that depends on content. The first match sets the exposure.

rule.description: A content rule. It reads one argument and, if it fires, sets the call's exposure.

arg.description: Dotted path to the argument this rule reads.

count.description: Regular expression. The rule fires when the argument contains at least `min` matches.

min.description: Minimum number of matches of `count` for the rule to fire.

per_match.description: Multiply exposure by the number of matches of `count`.

match.description: Regular expression. The rule fires when the argument matches it.

not_match.description: Regular expression. The rule fires when the argument does not match it.

exposure.description: Exposure set by this rule when it fires.
